title: How Large Language Models Work
visual_thesis: Large language models turn text into tokens, mix context through transformer layers, then predict the next token again and again.
central_object: A row of token cards becoming vectors, flowing through a transformer, and growing one token at a time.
primary_transformation: Readable text becomes token vectors, the vectors become context-aware, and prediction becomes a repeated generation loop.

scenes.viewer_question: What does an LLM actually read?
scenes.visual_object: a sentence splitting into token cards
scenes.motion: A sentence separates into small token cards.
scenes.meaning: The model sees token IDs, not raw English paragraphs.
scenes.caption: The hidden trick is that text becomes tokens first.

scenes.motion: Each token card drops into a small vector of numbers.
scenes.meaning: Meaning becomes position in a learned numerical space.
scenes.caption: Each token becomes a vector of numbers.

scenes.viewer_question: How does the model use context?
scenes.visual_object: one token sending attention arrows to nearby tokens
scenes.motion: Arrows connect the current token to the tokens that change its meaning.
scenes.meaning: Attention lets a token borrow context from the rest of the sentence.
scenes.caption: Attention lets each token look at the others for context.

scenes.visual_object: vectors passing through attention and MLP blocks
scenes.motion: The same vectors pass through repeated transformer layers.
scenes.meaning: Layers mix context, transform features, and refine the representation.
scenes.caption: Transformer layers repeatedly mix and refine those vectors.

scenes.viewer_question: What is the model trying to output?
scenes.visual_object: a probability distribution over next-token choices
scenes.motion: A bar chart appears with one token getting the highest probability.
scenes.meaning: The immediate job is next-token prediction.
scenes.caption: The model predicts one next token, not a whole answer at once.

scenes.viewer_question: How does one token become a full answer?
scenes.visual_object: new tokens appended into a growing sentence
scenes.motion: The predicted token joins the prompt, then the loop repeats.
scenes.meaning: Long answers come from repeating the same prediction loop.
scenes.caption: Then the new token is fed back in and the loop continues.
